title: The Relational Velocity-Dispersion Spread: A Modified-Gravity-Impossible Signature of History-Dependent Inertia
description: In a modified-inertia (MI) reading of the MOND phenomenology, inertia is a time-nonlocal functional of a body's own worldline: its effective response depends on its acceleration history through a causal memory kernel K(Box_u/a0^2). This paper shows that this history-dependence generates a RELATIONAL signature that no modified-gravity (MG) theory of the standard class can reproduce in its FIELD SECTOR. For any theory that (P1) sources a gravitational field g(x) from the baryons and (P2) moves tracers on weak-equivalence-principle (WEP) geodesics of a single metric built from that field, a test body's acceleration at a fixed cluster-centric position is a function of position alone -- independent of how it arrived there. Consequently the EQUILIBRIUM internal velocity dispersion of a self-gravitating subsystem, at fixed external field, carries exactly zero spread across infall history: d(sigma_int)/d(history) = 0, structurally, because the field carries no worldline/history label. This is proven within the class {QUMOND, AQUAL, AeST/TeVeS, f(R), local-modified-g}, for any a0, any interpolation, both coefficient footings, off-adiabatically, and under retardation. CREDIT: the MG-zero baseline is Milgrom's MG-virial universality (Milgrom 1983 ApJ 270:365; 2014 MNRAS 437:2531); the interpolation kernel nu(y)=sqrt(1+1/y) is Milgrom's (Phys. Lett. A 253:273, 1999, Eq. 9). The novelty is (a) the general sourced-field-WEP proof of the exact-zero off-adiabatically and under retardation, (b) that the discriminant survives a strong-anisotropy control test (it is not re-labeled velocity anisotropy), (c) a designed, degeneracy-differencing observable D(zone)=<ln(sigma_int/sigma_bary)>_zone - <>_ancient computed within a fixed deprojected external-field bin and tagged by Rhee et al. (2017) phase-space infall zones, which differences the shared radial EFE gradient out as a common mode, and (d) the framework-specific prediction (the numbers, not the discriminating power). HONEST SCOPE, stated throughout: (i) the theorem is the MG FIELD MAP; the OBSERVED-existence claim is CONFOUND-CONTINGENT, because ordinary non-equilibrium dynamics (violent relaxation, tidal shocking, incomplete phase-mixing) produce fixed-field, history-correlated spreads in Newton+dark-matter and MG alike, and must be separated by design, not asserted by the theorem. (ii) The leading sign, in the first-infall pre-pericentre zone, is that first-infall members run HOTTER than matched long-resident members -- structural and timescale-free for any positive-averaging or pure-delay causal kernel, robust across a 0/125 orbit scan; this inverts and SUPERSEDES the backwards, dated pericentre sign-flip of the earlier Door D3 (No Pump-Free Corner, corrected in its v3 erratum). The MAGNITUDE is KERNEL-HOSTAGE: at the framework-committed memory time it ranges from ~1.3% (low-pass reading) to ~8-13% (pure-delay |K|=1 reading) in the fixed-field ln(sigma_int/sigma_bary) contrast, not pinned by the de Sitter-Unruh foundation; at the low end it sits at or below the observable's own ~1-2% projection and ~2-8% tidal systematic floors. TWO physical channels are distinguished: a star-orbit channel within one pressure-supported system (sub-percent, deep-adiabatic, tau_mem=2Z/H_Lambda~203/168 Gyr, ELT-gated) and the nearer, larger cluster-member infall-phase EFE channel. POWER: underpowered today -- a public-data feasibility scout (MultimodalUniverse MaNGA + DESI DR1 membership) returns a NO-GO on the diffuse-carrier count (~40-77); a MaNGA+SAMI stack reaches ~135-237 (an underpowered, firewalled hint); a clean detection needs a dedicated wide dwarf-IFU cluster survey or ELT/HARMONI (~2032). The signature is MI-CLASS-GENERIC -- it separates any history-dependent inertia from modified gravity, but NOT this framework from Milgrom's linear no-EFE MI (arXiv:2503.07106, which also spreads) -- and does NOT test a0's value or the sign s=-1 (both postulates; the leading sign rides on s=-1). A prediction-and-methods paper for a designed, currently-underpowered discriminator, honest in both directions. Every load-bearing claim is backed by a committed, adversarially verified, exit-0 script.
notes: Referee-graded writeup (draft -> 4-reviewer adversarial panel [physics/honesty/citation/rigor] -> revise). The panel tightened the framing to match the banked verification: the MG=0 result is scoped to the FIELD SECTOR (theorem-grade), while the observed-existence claim is confound-contingent (non-equilibrium dynamics produce same-signed spreads in Newton+DM and MG); the magnitude is stated as kernel-hostage (~1.3% low-pass to ~8-13% pure-delay), at or below its own systematic floors at the low end. Consolidates and supersedes Door D3 of 'No Pump-Free Corner' (concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21179351), whose backwards sign-flip is corrected in that paper's v3 erratum. Companion to 'MI Field Theory Results 2026' (10.5281/zenodo.21403470) and the lensing no-go (10.5281/zenodo.21418816). Both a0 footings carried on every number; Milgrom credited (nu-kernel + MG-virial universality + EFE subsystem boost); no 'proves/solved' language for the framework; a0's value and s=-1 remain postulates. https://github.com/carlzimmerman/zimmerman-formula
